info.description: A recurring WebX Agent background job (webx-studio lib/agent/jobs/schedules.ts). The tick advances it only through the secret-protected /api/internal/agent-schedules/* endpoints, each a compare-and-set on runSeq; never written through the generic entries route.

ownerUserId.description: The owner's account id when the schedule was saved. A different id for the same email later means a different person, and the schedule turns off.

recurrence.description: { freq: daily | weekly | monthly, byWeekday?, byMonthDay? (1-28), hour, minute (0/15/30/45), tz }

countedJobId.description: The last finished job already counted toward consecutiveFailures.

disabledReason.description: owner_revoked | policy_changed | plan | reauthorize | failures | template | user

authorizedUntil.description: 90 days after the owner last saved or turned the schedule on; after that it turns off until they confirm it again.

runSeq.description: Bumped by every tick change; the compare-and-set token.
